SV coverage + matched POIs
Black rectangle: POI_BBOX (OSM extraction region, ≈ 3.8 × 3.9 km).
● Matched POIs (212) — VLM-named via poi_scan; the anchors the targeted crawl was built around. Points as dots, streets as polylines along the actual road. Size / weight ∝ log(frames+1). (15 POIs whose geometry sits > 300 m from any pano are excluded — see data/cities/zurich/outlier_pois.json.)
● SV panos bought (1108) — the GPS-known reference photos DINOv2 matches against.
● Available but not bought (807, toggle on) — red dots: panos Google has in the bbox that we deliberately skipped (outside the 150 m POI buffer). Toggle on to see where we left gaps.
DINOv2-detected POI layer omitted for now — will be added back after the next gps_recovery run on the full 1,108-pano set.
